notes: SWP (Guerin quoted): the great square tower (Burj) stands "at its eastern extremity" of the site hill and the rock-cut birket is "beside the Burj", so the birket is coded "east part" relative to the unit; this is a two-step reading (birket beside a tower that is at the east end). The cisterns are "near it" (the birket), with no direction: position none. Packet page for the entry is 30, but the printed running head in the text reads 235. Own row moat not coded. Tumuli at S618/S546 coded as graves (burial mounds; burial not stated explicitly). Sheikh Smeit tomb dated L.
